definitions.explanation: Requiring great effort, skill, or intelligence. The opposite of {易|やさ}しい (easy).

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難|むずか}しい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難|むずか}し⟦すぎます→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
{難|むずか}しい⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めません→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
{難|むずか}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていました→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦やって→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦みたら→見る：00283_miru⟧{難|むずか}しかった⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I thought it wouldn't be difficult, but when I tried it, it was hard.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{難|むずか}しい⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦ずつ→ずつ：03092_zutsu⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいます→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: This book is difficult, but I'm reading it little by little every day.

notes:
{難|むずか}しい is an i-adjective meaning "difficult" or "hard."

FORMS:
- Adverb: {難|むずか}しく
- Noun form: {難|むずか}しさ (difficulty)
- Negative: {難|むずか}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧

SPELLING NOTE:
The correct reading is むずかしい. An older/dialectal variant むつかしい exists but is rarely used.

USAGE RANGE:
- Tasks/problems: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{難|むずか}しい (the problem is difficult)
- People: {難|むずか}しい⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (a difficult/hard-to-please person)
- Situations: {難|むずか}しい⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (a difficult situation)
- Abstract: {難|むずか}しい⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ (a difficult decision)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{易|やさ}しい→易しい：00765_yasashii⟧: easy (same kanji pattern)
- ⟦{簡単|かんたん}→簡単：00713_kantan⟧な: simple, easy

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {難|むずか}しい⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: it's not difficult
- {難|むずか}しく⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧: to overthink
